meta_title: Summaries of pages, PDFs and videos in one click
meta_desc: {{displayName}} is a free browser extension that turns long pages, PDFs and videos into clear key points, in your language.
cta_note: Free extension for Chrome. Firefox coming next.
hero_title: Any page, PDF or video. The point in one click.
hero_sub: {{displayName}} turns long pages, PDFs and videos into clear key points, in the language you choose.
hero_img_alt: {{displayName}} popup next to an article, with the Summarize button
how1_d: An article, a PDF, or a video with subtitles.
how2_d: Click the icon. The text is sent only at that moment, and only for that page.
how3_d: A short summary appears right on the page, in the language you chose.
works_pdf_d: Online, or a file on your disk opened in the browser.
works_video_d: YouTube and any video with subtitles. With Premium, also videos without subtitles, from the audio.
privacy_1: The text of the page — or the subtitles, the PDF text, or for Premium the audio — is sent to our servers and to OpenAI only when you press Summarize. Nothing is read in the background.
privacy_2: A copy of the result is kept for up to 24 hours to avoid repeating the same work. Video transcripts are deleted within 24 hours. PDF files are not stored.
privacy_3: Usage statistics keep only the site domain — never the full address, the page title or your email — for at most 13 months.
privacy_4: Your data is never sold. You sign in with your Google account.
plan_text: 5 summaries to try, then 1 per day. Premium — unlimited summaries and audio transcription of videos without subtitles — is coming soon.
langs_text: Interface in English, Italian, Spanish, French and German. Summaries in the language you choose.
faq1_a: Only when you press Summarize. The text of the page — or the subtitles, the PDF text, or for Premium the video audio — goes to our servers and to OpenAI to generate the summary. Nothing is read or sent in the background.
faq2_q: What do you store, and for how long?
faq2_a: Your account data (name, email) for as long as the account exists. A copy of each result for up to 24 hours. Video transcripts for at most 24 hours. Usage events keep only the site domain, for at most 13 months. PDF files are not stored.
faq4_a: 5 to try, then 1 per day. Premium, with unlimited summaries, is coming soon.
faq5_q: What content does it work on?
faq5_a: Web pages, PDF documents (also a local file opened in the browser), YouTube and any video with subtitles. With Premium, also videos without subtitles, transcribed from the audio.
faq6_a: The interface is in English, Italian, Spanish, French and German. The summary is written in the language you choose in the extension.
faq7_q: How do I delete my account, or get help?
faq7_a: Write to contact@bifa.digital. Your account and data are deleted on request.
footer_rights: A product of Bifa SRLS, Torino, Italy.
ty_text: Your plan is active. Open the extension and keep reading, without limits.
cx_text: Nothing was charged. You can try again any time from the extension.
nf_text: The page you asked for does not exist.
